messages:
Mira: Quick sync — Emerald-6B intake. Can we confirm ownership + gating checklist so we can mark this ready for the catalog? High-level asks: licensing status, perf profile (latency/cost), quantization compatibility, infra/canary owner. cc @Sam @Oliver @Tess
Sam: I can own the ML side for Emerald-6B. I'll run our eval suite + perf profile and try 8-bit quant runs. Initial numbers look reasonable but need the quant QA. ETA: perf + report by EOD today, full 8-bit QA within 24h. @Mira any specific prompt sets to include?
Mira: Please include the standard onboard prompt set: low-latency chat, long-context summarization, and embeddings equivalence. See /evals/standard/onboard_promptset_v2 (link). Also add a short multi-turn conversation benchmark.
Oliver: Infra/canary owner here. We can schedule a canary on dedicated pool next week (slot availability Wed). Need model artifacts (fp16 + quantized), an init script, and a memory estimate. If Sam can drop artifacts today I can provision the canary. Also call out which pool (dedicated-east-2?).
Sam: Quick init snippet for infra:
```
model_path=/artifacts/emerald6b/v1
--load-8bit
--kv-cache=on
--max-seq=2048
```
I'll upload artifacts + checksum in ~30m. Memory estimates: ~22GB (fp16), ~12GB (8-bit quant). Perf note: 8-bit latency ~+5-8% vs fp16 in our baseline.
Tess: Product note — legal signoff required before public catalog. Legal flagged a new CLA for this upstream model. Also we need a proposed rollout window: aiming to surface in the catalog next Tue, but that's contingent on legal + canary. @legal-bot any update?
legal-bot: Legal checklist for open-model intake:
• License compatibility: preliminary check passed (CC-BY-4.0 variant)
• Export control: clear
• Provenance (third-party weights + repo URL + SHA): pending — we need the exact source URL + SHA256 of the weights and the commit hash.
Please upload the documents to the intake ticket (INTAKE-1123) and tag @Tess.
Sam: Uploading model URL + SHA256 now to INTAKE-1123. Also will paste artifact links here once upload completes. Running 8-bit QA; will include the multi-turn prompts Mira mentioned.
Mira: :thumbsup: Action items summary to keep this moving:
- Sam: perf report + artifacts + SHA (ETA: today)
- Oliver: canary setup Wed after artifacts available
- Legal: provenance check after SHA uploaded
- Tess: draft catalog listing + short risk note
We'll re-evaluate Thurs morning in async. Anyone want to add or object?
Oliver: :eyes: No objections. Small infra FYI: canary may temporarily increase GPU quota on dedicated-east-2. I'll open a capacity ticket and link it to INTAKE-1123.
Tess: Noted. I'll start a draft of the listing and ping design for an icon. If legal needs any extra docs I'll coordinate.
Mira: Great — thanks all. I'll follow up Thurs AM if anything blocks.
